info.name: ZoomInfo Authentication Corporate Hierarchy Enrich API

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to match corporate hierarchical information based on [input values](#d72da288-2069-47c9-b36f-16cdab5d9988) and return the desired [output fields](#d6813026-dcae-4b20-9ee4-b1301451a2c7) in the response.

**Input params**

| Parameter | DataType | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| companyId | Integer | Unique ZoomInfo identifier for a company |
| companyName | String | Company name |
| companyWebsite | String | Company website URL in [http://www.example.com](http://www.example.
Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the [Corporate Hierarchy Enrich](#1bf83184-9ee9-478f-b839-9afab4dfe18e) endpoint.
Returns a list of fields you can specify as output for the [Corporate Hierarchy Enrich](#1bf83184-9ee9-478f-b839-9afab4dfe18e) endpoint.
